meta.title: Our process
meta.description: A clear path from discovery to launch. See how AJS Technologies collaborates, designs, builds, and supports your digital project.

title: Big ambition.
intro: You should always know what we’re building, why it matters, and what happens next. Our process creates space for good ideas and keeps the work moving.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: First, we get curious. We listen to your goals, understand the people you serve, and explore your existing tools and constraints.
outputs: An initial scope and delivery plan

steps.title: Design
steps.text: We turn understanding into a direction. User journeys, interface concepts, and technical decisions take shape before development starts.
outputs: Reviewed user journeys and key screens

steps.title: Develop
steps.text: We build in manageable stages. Regular previews, testing, and your feedback help us solve issues while the work is still taking shape.

steps.title: Deploy & evolve
steps.text: Launch is a beginning. We prepare the handover, help you get comfortable, and discuss what ongoing support should look like.
outputs: An agreed support and improvement plan

principles.title: Visible progress
principles.text: See the work as it develops, with review points agreed from the start.

principles.title: Decisions together
principles.text: Understand the tradeoffs and help shape the decisions that affect your business.

principles.title: Room to adapt
principles.text: When priorities shift, we discuss the impact and update the plan together.
